class.name: GameLogFileHandler
class.brief_description: Writes a logger's lines to a file.
class.description: Made by [method open], which starts the file afresh. Every line is on the disk at once: a log that explains a crash must not lose its end in the file's buffer.

method.name: open
method.description: The handler of a new file at [param path], its directory made; null when the file cannot be opened.
